beats.text: Hit the middle, through the valve

The air flows unevenly.
It wobbles and dips late.

script: No spin. All chaos. Messi bends free kicks with spin. These players take the spin away. It's called a knuckleball. Hit the middle of the ball, through the valve, with a short, stiff follow-through. Almost no spin. Without spin, the air doesn't flow around the ball evenly, so it wobbles and dips late. The keeper can't read it. Sometimes, neither can the shooter. Try it at your next session, and tag who's in goal.
caption:
Messi bends it with spin. The knuckleball kills the spin. ⚽

How it works:
• Strike the middle of the ball, through the valve.
• Short, stiff follow-through.
• Almost no spin, so the air flows around the ball unevenly. It wobbles and dips late, and the keeper can't read it.

Try it at your next session and tag who's in goal 👇 Follow @wearecancha for more.
